cohort: Births at a tertiary center (4743 births from March 2019-February 2020 and 4522 births from March 2020-February 2021)
finding: The COVID-19 pandemic was associated with a slight decrease in birth rate and a longer mean gestational age at birth, but there were no significant differences in other birth outcomes between the pandemic and pre-pandemic periods.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at birth was measured
